subject: bia
title: BIA.------AFI.
description: Diagram in PCC-25, the first of two on book p341, where Braxton specifies the AFI(1) and AFI(2) bifurcation in diagram form. (C)BIA (the *concept* of bi-aitional, the masculine/feminine dual-principle structure) is crossed with AFI (affinity insight). The diagram contains all three AFI nodes — AFI, AFI-1, AFI-2 — making the affinity-insight bifurcation diagrammatic. The main line bends at (R)C-INFO (the reality of composite information): BIA → (R)C-INFO → AFI. AFI has a *dashed* edge to AFI-2 (the second-degree affinity insight), and AFI-2 → SOC-RT (social reality). AFI also has a dashed edge to AFI-1 (the first-degree affinity insight), and AFI-1 → PR-TRS. ACT (activism) and DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) branch from the C-INFO → AFI stretch, and COS-P (cosmic particulars) branches from DYM-F. C-INFO also → PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) → (R)ATTN (the reality of attraction).
